يكتنفوا (form VIII)
# يَكْتَنِفُوا (yaktanifū) /jak.ta.ni.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# يُكْتَنَفُوا (yuktanafū) /juk.ta.na.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
